name: kungfu-noodles-website
description: Conversion-focused website for Kungfu Noodles, Thamel, Kathmandu.

scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run menu
scripts.check: npm run check:html && npm run check:js && npm run check:links && npm run check:menu
scripts.check:html: html-validate index.html menu.html order.html contact.html credits.html 404.html
scripts.check:js: node --check assets/js/main.js && node --check assets/js/menu.js && node --check assets/js/order.js && node --check assets/js/contact.js
